topics.topic: Refusal side effects in multi-step operations: must prior successful writes be rolled back or can they persist?
questions: When an operation performs multiple store changes and later fails, is the required behavior full rollback of all earlier successful changes, or preserving earlier successful changes?
If an operation returns a refusal code (`internal_error`), must all prior writes in that request be rolled back, or may earlier successful store changes remain?

topics.topic: get_repair_view pagination: is the NodeExecution implementation filter frozen from page 1 or recomputed on continuation?
questions: For `get_repair_view` pagination, is the NodeExecution filter set (slot implementations) frozen from page 1 or recomputed on each continuation request?
When continuing `get_repair_view`, is the NodeExecution filter fixed to the implementation set from page 1, or recomputed from the slot's current implementation set on each request?

topics.topic: read_spooled_file refusal precedence/check order when multiple failure conditions apply
questions: If both conditions hold (the run no longer holds spool, and the supplied SpooledFile identity does not exist), which refusal must be returned?
For owner calls, when both conditions are potentially relevant (record exists but bytes removed / run no longer holds spool), what exact check order is normative for returned code?

topics.topic: Deterministic precondition/refusal check order for effects.grant_standing_approval
questions: What is the mandatory check order when multiple grant preconditions fail, so the refusal reason is deterministic?

topics.topic: Deterministic processing order for recovering multiple in_flight attempts
questions: In what deterministic order are multiple `in_flight` attempts recovered and written?

topics.topic: NodeExecution executed-field data model and exact filter field names (union field vs separate nullable fields)
questions: Is executed target stored as one union field (`executed`) or as two separate nullable fields (`executed_implementation`/`executed_binding`), and what exact field names are exposed for filtering?

topics.topic: Query-string encoding for empty list inputs (omit parameter vs explicit empty form)
questions: How is an empty list input encoded in the query string: omitted entirely, or present as an empty parameter form?

topics.topic: Scope of "every header the kernel sends" in request descriptions (kernel-constructed only vs including transport/client-added headers)
questions: Does "every header the kernel sends" include transport/client-added headers (for example Host, Content-Length, multipart boundary-bearing Content-Type), or only headers constructed by kernel rules?

topics.topic: bindings.check_binding_current output schema: whether ManifestOperation includes selected instance name
questions: Does `ManifestOperation` include selected instance name as a field in this operation output, or is only `base_url`/`required_headers`/`instance_class` returned?

topics.topic: store.read_records behavior for duplicate identities (deduplication and required output order)
questions: When `store.read_records` is called by identity with duplicates, does it deduplicate, and if so what output order is required?

topics.topic: store.spool_file attempt cleanup semantics when spooling is performed per-file
questions: How is "nothing kept ... of any file that attempt spooled before" enforced when spooling is called per-file?
